description: React component LiveVitalsChart.tsx that renders a live updating multi-series vital signs chart with simulated data streams. Includes configuration, state management, axes scaling, normalization, and rendering of SVG chart elements.

methods.name: stepValue
methods.description: Helper to generate the next value for a vital series with noise, baseline pull, spikes, and clamping.

methods.name: toggleRun
methods.description: Toggle the streaming simulation between running and paused states.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Reset all series points to their baseline states.

methods.name: toggleSeries
methods.description: Toggle the visibility of a specific vital series.

methods.name: formatTimeLabel
methods.description: Format timestamp into relative time label (e.g., -30s).

methods.name: xScale
methods.description: Map a timestamp to X coordinate in SVG based on current window.

methods.name: yNorm
methods.description: Normalize a vital value to 0..1 based on series min/max range.

methods.name: yFromNorm
methods.description: Convert normalized value (0..1) to Y coordinate in SVG for axes.

methods.name: pathFor
methods.description: Generate SVG path string for a given vital series.
